note: Gratiot County zones six townships (Elba, Hamilton, Lafayette, Newark, North Star, Sumner); the county planning page publishes their zoning maps only as JPEG images, and the City of Alma publishes its zoning map as a PDF. The county GIS viewer (FetchGIS, a commercial vendor) shows a Zoning field with no data and names no public ArcGIS service. The county's own ArcGIS account (services.arcgis.com/RukRjumVrIALMGTk) holds Civil_Divisions and a 2024 parcel layer with no zoning field. No queryable zoning district polygon service was found for Gratiot County or its cities.
